Verdict

## Numbers Rerun after fixes. `renderdiff: 6 of 6 routes differ (22 of 30 shots), 0 errors`. Widths 600, 1000, 1240, 1440, 1600. Head rebuilt with `bun run --filter marketing build`; base 17ce7e299 built the same way. Base vs base: 0 of 30 shots differ (37 px unstable on /product/embedded-analytics; the flexboxgrid CDN stylesheet failed on both sides in that run). ## Fixed - /changelog @1000: single 678 px column with the TopBar drawer, same as the md layout. The 40 px column is gone. - /blog/metabase-doesnt-use-php @1600: clean. The newsletter iframe at 620 px now matches base exactly. - Heading sizes: no font-size or line-height changes at 1240 or 1440 on /upgrade, /cloud, /product/embedded-analytics or /features/metabase-ai. ## Still differing outside the nav - /product/embedded-analytics @1000: the two TabsWithTimer sections (customer stories, "Easy to use") switch at 64rem, while the page's Bootstrap `col-lg-6` columns still switch at 992. Between 992 and 1023 the tabs use md styles (100 px buttons, so the Sincera logo is clipped; 16 px labels; no 6rem text padding) beside lg side-by-side columns, so image and text touch. The page is 289 px shorter. ContactBox (`width < 64rem`) also switches: its icon goes 30 px → 24 px. - /features/metabase-ai @1000: nav only, plus the ContactBox icon at 30 px → 24 px. - /changelog, /features/metabase-ai, /product/embedded-analytics @600: one region inside the cookie banner text. The banner geometry is identical on both sides, so this is raster noise, not layout. ## Expected (in band) @600: containers go full width. @1000: hamburger nav and md layouts. @1240: containers 1140 → 960, "What's new" hidden. @1440: GitHub stars hidden, containers 1320 → 1140. /cloud follows the same pattern. 1600 is clean on all routes. ## Not verified Six routes only; no hover or open-menu states; media and iframes masked. Reference is a local base build. ## Call Both earlier regressions are fixed. One remaining mismatch on legacy pages at 992–1023: TabsWithTimer and ContactBox use Tailwind lg while the surrounding Bootstrap grid uses 992.

    • iframes (--mask-media)

    Pinned on both sides: clock starts at 2026-10-30T16:03:00.000Z on every load, a seeded Math.random, timezone UTC, locale en-US, light colour scheme, reduced motion, CSS animations and transitions off, animated images and SVG animations held on their first frame, videos kept from playing with video.js overlays hidden.

    Unstable pixels — ones that changed between two shots of the same load — are painted magenta on both sides, counted on each card, and excluded from the measurement. A route more than 25% unstable is an error.

    Magenta is also padding where one page is taller or wider than the other. It counts against the score on purpose — see the height delta on the row.
